headline: Computational frameworks resolve cell, isoform and allele assignment in sequencing data
label: Nucleic Acid Sequencing Analysis Tools
summary: Single-cell and long-read resources increasingly formalize cell identity and reference handling before biological inference.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational frameworks that assign measurements to the correct unit before inference: individual cells, malignant versus normal populations, isoforms with cell-resolved evidence, and alleles. CATFISHR combines expression similarity with inferred CNV profiles to identify malignant cells, and scTHREAD links isoform, poly(A), junction and allelic evidence per cell in long-read data. Other items address integration across modalities and datasets: rpMeta meta-analyzes RNA-seq and proteomics, ConcuRx integrates heterogeneous CRISPR drug-response screens, and the pan-cancer benchmark evaluates patient-specific gene regulatory networks across 9,778 tumors. What is newer is avoidance of prior discretization: DiCoLo detects localized coexpression without integration or clustering, and RFind-sc projects single cells onto externally defined axes. CellDEEP evaluates metacell-based differential expression against single-cell and pseudobulk methods.
